text.en:
On Barricade Placement:
Unleashes a <solar/>Solar Wave that returns back to the Barricade after 18.5 metres.

<solar/>Solar Wave deals <pve 240 /> <pvp [100] /> damage.

<solar/>Solar Kills refresh 25% of Class Ability Energy.
text.ko:
방벽 시전 시:
18.5미터를 나아간 뒤 다시 방벽으로 돌아오는 태양 파동을 내보냅니다.
<pvp 100 피해를 줍니다. />

태양 처치 시 직업 능력 에너지 25%를 반환합니다.

On Barricade Placement:
Unleashes a <solar/>Solar Wave that returns back to the Barricade after traveling 18.5 meters.

<solar/>Solar Wave deals <pve 240 /> <pvp [100] /> damage and applies <pve 60 /> <pvp [30] /> Scorch (unchanged with Ember of Ashes).

Enemies that are hit by the Wave cannot be damaged by <solar/>Solar Wave for 2 seconds. Wave does not apply Scorch while returning.

<solar/>Solar Kills grant 25% Class Ability Energy.

<solar/>Solar Kills grant 15% Class Ability Energy. 1? second cooldown between activations.

Upon casting a Barricade Class Ability:
Unleashes a <solar/>Solar Wave from the front of the barricade that returns to the Barricade after traveling 18.5 meters or colliding with map geometry.

The Wave deals <pve 480 /> <pvp [100] /> damage and applies <pve 60 /> <pvp [30] /> <solar/>Scorch Stacks (<pve 90 /> <pvp [45] /> with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).

Damage and <solar/>Scorch are separately applied by both the initial and returning waves. <solar/>Solar Wave is not affected by <solar/>Roaring Flames.

<solar/>Solar Kills grant 15% Class Ability Energy. 1? second cooldown between activations.

Upon casting a Barricade Class Ability with a <solar/>Solar Super equipped:
Unleashes 3 <solar/>Solar Waves from the front of the barricade that travel 18.5 meters and have tracking capabilities.

The Waves deal <pve 480 /> <pvp [100] /> damage and apply <pve 60 /> <pvp [30] /> <solar/>Scorch Stacks (<pve 90 /> <pvp [45] /> with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).

Enemies <pve Hit /> <pvp [Killed] /> by the Waves leave behind a <solar/>Sunspot at their location.

<solar/>Solar Wave is not affected by <solar/>Roaring Flames.
